paragraphs.text: God is a creature type representing powerful divine beings like deities. The word "god" is used gender neutrally, meaning it can signify a male or female.

Gods appear in all colors and are usually legendary . However, Marvel Super Heroes Commander introduced 2 non-legendary creatures with the god creature type: Valkyrior Skyrider ( Marvel Super Heroes Commander ) and Sif's Spearmaster ( Marvel Super Heroes Commander ).
Gods and deities had been a part of Magic since the beginning of its lore.

The Myojin -cycle can be seen as the precursor to the god creature type, although they are legendary spirits. Mark Rosewater has stated if they had been designed under the current design vision, the cards would have been creature-type God, likely Spirit God or God Spirit.

God was originally introduced as a creature type for the Theros block , which was inspired by Greek-mythology and the Greek pantheon. The creature type "God" is used for both male and female gods, both because a word longer than "God" wouldn't have fit on the card's type line after " Legendary Enchantment Creature " and because R&D didn't want to have to refer to "God or Goddess" on cards that interacted with them. However, the creature type "Demigod" later appeared in Theros Beyond Death ; they solved the issue of the words not fitting on the type line by making the text smaller.

Amonkheti gods are manifestations of the plane's leylines . Due to their nature, Nicol Bolas was able to manipulate the leylines to twist the gods to his own ends. He left 5 gods to oversee the Trials of the Five Gods , and 3 more corrupted gods to play other roles during the Final Hours .
The Deep Gods are children of Chimil and the gods of the Oltec .

O-Kagachi was the most powerful kami, the great kami of all things, and the guardian of the realms of Kakuriyo and Utsushiyo and the boundary between them. In 3207 AR, Lord Takeshi Konda stole the great kami's "heart" and a portion of its power. The act enraged O-Kagachi, starting the Kami War
Kyodai is the child of O-Kagachi and took over the great kami's role of guarding the boundary between realms alongside Michiko after O-Kagachi's death.
The five Myojin are the most powerful kami on Kamigawa after O-Kagachi. Each represents one of the five colors of mana.

Each sapient species on Kamigawa has a patron kami represents and embodies the collective unconscious of that species. These kami were worshiped and revered as gods up to the Kami War . Even then, a small group of worshipers remained, hoping to appease these gods with increased worship.

The ancient Einir were once the ruling gods of the plane, believed to channel the essence of the World Tree through their connection to Koma . They were responsible for sealing the demons in Innistrum. Kaldheim elves are their decedents.
The Skoti challenged the power of the Einir and took over their role as the plane's gods. Their divine power comes from the Cosmos Elixir created from Tyrite .
Theran gods are living enchantments shaped by the beliefs of the plane's inhabitants.

Dungeons & Dragons: Adventures in the Forgotten Realms and Commander Legends: Battle for Baldur's Gate featured legendary creature cards for various deities from the Dungeons & Dragons franchise, including: Asmodeus , Bane , Bhaal , Myrkul , and Tiamat .
Bahamut and Lolth also appeared as planeswalkers in Dungeons & Dragons: Adventures in the Forgotten Realms .

The Lord of the Rings: Tales of Middle-earth printed Tom Bombadil ( The Lord of the Rings: Tales of Middle-earth ) as a God Bard . Assassin's Creed , Final Fantasy , and Marvel Super Heroes included gods from throughout their respective franchises, and the Playstation Superdrop included gods from the God of War franchise.
Because other IPs vary in their treatment of deities, their design in Universes Beyond products such as Final Fantasy and Assassin's Creed varies as well.
Many Gods have indestructible , an ability that makes them difficult to destroy, or allows them to recur. Which they have is dictated by which mythology and pantheon they are inspired by.

Some gods have mechanics that take away their creature type or restrict their ability to attack or block unless a certain condition is met. For example, Theran gods are only creatures while their controller's devotion to their color is high enough: five for monocolored and seven for two-colored, of which the God itself either supplies one or two, otherwise, they are legendary noncreature enchantments. In contrast, the five original Amonkhet mono-colored gods, Ketramose , and Sab-Sunen have can't attack or block unless certain conditions are met.
Cacophony Unleashed is an enchantment that can become a legendary 6/6 Nightmare God creature with menace and deathtouch.
